content:
Priya (partnerships): starting a short sync for the marketplace listing uploads (AWS/GCP/Azure). main goals: final SKU mapping, legal artifacts, publisher creds, and quickstarts. who can own which cloud? :spiral_calendar:
Marco (product): I'll own the SKU matrix and copy for the listing. will propose trial limits and metering names.
Jenna (legal): I'll take the legal artifacts and commercial terms. need to confirm marketplace-specific terms for refunds and data handling.
Omar (eng-ops): I'll handle creds and deployment manifests per cloud. need a template for IAM/service accounts.
Ravi (devex): I'll produce the quickstart, sample terraform, and screenshots for the store.
infra-bot: Created ticket MKT-2892: Publish listing assets + creds checklist. Assignee: Priya. Due: 72 hours.
Priya (partnerships): thanks. Marco, can you start with a mapping for meters so billing aligns across clouds? GCP names need to match our invoice line items.
Marco (product): drafting now. rough plan:
```
- meter.tokens = redwood.tokens
- meter.embedding = redwood.embedding
- trial.tokens = redwood.trial_tokens
```
I'll add pricing tiers and payg vs reserved mapping.
Jenna (legal): question on telemetry: marketplaces often require a diagnostic contact and a short statement on data retention. do we want opt-in only, or opt-out with notice?
Ravi (devex): from UX of previous listings, opt-in on first run works better. i'll add a sample flag `enable_marketplace_telemetry=true` and show how to opt out.
Omar (eng-ops): infra checklist snippet (placeholder IDs):
```
AWS: role arn:aws:iam::111222333444:role/redwood-marketplace-publisher
GCP: service account: redwood-marketplace@redwood-prod.iam.gserviceaccount.com
Azure: appId: 11111111-2222-3333-4444-555555555555
```
I'll replace with real IDs after infra provisioning.
Priya (partnerships): good. Marco, also include SKU aliasing for "Hosted API", "Dedicated Pools", and "Embeddings" so marketing names match the marketplace tiles.
Marco (product): noted. will push a spreadsheet link in 1hr.
Jenna (legal): also flagging: Azure listing needs a publisher agreement PDF and a contact for legal requests. Priya, who should be listed?
Priya (partnerships): list legal@redwood.ai as the primary legal contact, and marketplace-billing@redwood.ai for billing.
Ravi (devex): assets checklist: hero (1200x600) + thumbnail (600x300), 3 screenshots, one short intro video (30s). I'll compress and upload assets.zip to the shared drive.
Marco (product): quick note on trials: propose 5k trial tokens, valid 14 days. limits at API-key level to prevent abuses.
Jenna (legal): 14 days + 5k tokens sounds fine; will add a clause to the trial terms limiting commercial use and automated scraping.
Omar (eng-ops): technical caveat: for GCP we need to provide a billing SKU mapping; their portal requires exact SKU strings. Marco please make them exact.
Marco (product): will ensure exact labels.
Priya (partnerships): can we also include a short FAQ for marketplace reviewers about data residency and encryption at rest? reviewers ask that.
Ravi (devex): adding FAQ section in README: KMS options, regional model deployment (EU-only), and SOC/ISO links.
infra-bot: Reminder: MKT-2892 status check in 48 hours.
Omar (eng-ops): edge note for AWS: some customers request an AMI for on-prem proxy. do we intend to provide an AMI artifact in the listing or link to a private bucket?
Priya (partnerships): prefer linking to a private staging bucket and a signed access flow. we avoid exposing AMIs publicly for now. mention as "by request" in the listing.
Jenna (legal): also ensure licensing text for model weights is explicit if we reference any 3rd-party models. Marco, list any non-Redwood model names.
Marco (product): only curated open-models; will include license references and attribution.
Ravi (devex): terraform example will avoid secrets. will use `var.publisher_sa_email` and sample env vars. Example snippet in README:
```
module "redwood_marketplace" {
  source = "github.com/redwood/marketplace-module"
  publisher_sa = var.publisher_sa_email
}
```
Priya (partnerships): timeline check: target upload to AWS/GCP/Azure sandboxes in 3 business days, final publish next week. everyone good?
All: +1 / ack / sounds good.
Marco (product): I'll upload the SKU spreadsheet into the shared drive and ping here.
Jenna (legal): will drop redline for the EULA and publisher agreement by EOD tomorrow.
Omar (eng-ops): infra requested 24-36hrs to generate real IDs.
Ravi (devex): assets zipping now, will post link in thread when done.
Priya (partnerships): perfect. if blockers surface, @channel. closing this thread for now, will reopen with links to the PRs and the ticket when available. :white_check_mark:
